our_interpretation: Assess two factual components: abandonment of the metaverse by the post and repeated unsuccessful products modeled on competitors.
'Track record' means repeated documented instances, not that every competing product failed.
Use failure to attract sustained use followed by withdrawal as ordinary evidence of competitive failure; no market-share threshold was supplied.
The historical scope is the company history invoked in the surrounding twenty-year comparison, ending at the post.
'While it may seem strange' is rhetorical framing, not a forecast condition. Wall Street's supposed appeal is an asserted motive that requires separate evidence.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish both abandonment of the metaverse and repeated unsuccessful products modeled on rivals. Evidence for only the repeated failures supports only that component.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Continuing metaverse activity contradicts abandonment. Competitive successes limit any broader suggestion of general inability to compete, although they do not erase repeated failures.
